short.en: Edit distance, put to work on typos

t.zh: 你打出了 ACROS。词典里有几个候选词，哪个离它最近？
t.en: You typed ACROS. The dictionary has a few candidate words: which one is closest to it?

t.zh: 「最近」就是改动最少：<wiki-ref to="edit"></wiki-ref>。托盘里的<part-ref to="cost"></part-ref>，算的就是它。
t.en: “Closest” means fewest changes: the <wiki-ref to="edit"></wiki-ref>. The <part-ref to="cost"></part-ref> in the tray works it out.

t.zh: 每个测试是一个候选词。三个测试都通过后，看看哪个候选词的步数最少。
t.en: Each test is one candidate word. Once all three tests pass, see which candidate needs the fewest steps.

goal.zh: 算出打错的词 ACROS 和每个候选词之间的编辑距离（删、插、换各算 1 步）。
goal.en: Work out the edit distance between the typo ACROS and each candidate word (delete, insert and replace each count as 1 step).

how.zh: <part-ref to="cost"></part-ref>在托盘里，接好它的五个输入就行。
how.en: The <part-ref to="cost"></part-ref> is in the tray: just wire up its five inputs.

hints.zh: 编辑距离器的五个口：左上、上面、左边、两字相同、是起点，照着接。
hints.en: The Edit Distance Meter’s five inputs: up-left, up, left, letters match, is start. Wire them up to match.

solution: e = cost(view.ul, view.up, view.left, facts.same, facts.start)

body.zh: 输入法和搜索框的「你是不是要找」，就是这样做的：把打出来的词和词典里的候选词一一比较，挑编辑距离最小的。
body.en: This is how keyboards and search boxes come up with “Did you mean…?”: compare the typed word with each candidate in the dictionary and pick the one with the smallest edit distance.

body.zh: 你没有重新拼电路，只是把编辑距离的元件拿过来，接到新问题上。
body.en: You didn’t build a new circuit: you just took the Edit Distance part and wired it into a new problem.

note.zh: 纠错：和每个候选词算编辑距离，挑最小的。
note.en: Spelling correction: work out the edit distance to each candidate and pick the smallest.
